title: Squares
task: Set result to a list of the squares of 1 through 10.
answer: result = [x * x for x in range(1, 11)]

title: Filter evens
task: From nums = [3, 8, 12, 5, 6, 9, 14], set result to the even numbers.
answer:
nums = [3, 8, 12, 5, 6, 9, 14]
result = [x for x in nums if x % 2 == 0]

title: Top 3

title: Word counts
task: Set result to a dict of word counts for text = 'a b a c b a'.
answer:
text = 'a b a c b a'
result = dict(Counter(text.split()))

title: Invert a dict
task: Given d = {'x': 1, 'y': 2}, set result to {1: 'x', 2: 'y'}.
hint: {v: k for k, v in d.items()}.
answer:
d = {'x': 1, 'y': 2}
result = {v: k for k, v in d.items()}

title: Write a function
task: Define pct(part, whole) returning part/whole*100 rounded to 1 decimal, and set result to pct(37, 120).

title: FizzBuzz list
task: Set result to the FizzBuzz list for 1–15 ('Fizz', 'Buzz', 'FizzBuzz', else the number as an int).
answer: result = ['FizzBuzz' if i % 15 == 0 else 'Fizz' if i % 3 == 0 else 'Buzz' if i % 5 == 0 else i for i in range(1, 16)]
